name: claude-fable-5-2
description: Claude Fable 5.2 is Anthropic's most capable model for the most demanding technical work, with gains over Fable 5.1 in coding, reasoning, and vision. In prerelease testing it completed otherwise-infeasible software migrations, designed working electronic devices from scratch, and made progress on open problems in physics and mathematics. It communicates more clearly than earlier Fable models and generates output up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1. Adaptive extended thinking is always on, with reasoning effort levels from low to max (default high) and preserved thinking across turns. Anthropic recommends Opus 5.5 as the daily driver for most coding and knowledge work, with Fable 5.2 for the most ambitious, open-ended problems.
zhDescription:
Claude Fable 5.2 是 Anthropic 面向高难度技术工作的能力最强模型，相较 Fable 5.1 在编程、推理与视觉能力方面均有提升。在预发布测试中，它完成了此前难以实现的软件迁移任务，从零设计出可运行的电子设备，并在物理和数学开放性难题上取得进展。模型表达较早期 Fable 系列更加清晰，输出速度最高比 Fable 5.1 提升 30%。

模型始终启用自适应扩展思考，推理强度支持从 low 到 max，默认为 high，并可跨轮次保留思考过程。Anthropic 建议大多数日常编程与知识工作优先使用 Opus 5.5，而将 Fable 5.2 用于更具挑战性、开放性更强的问题。

usageGuide.authIntro: 使用 API Key 进行认证，在请求头中添加 x-api-key 和 anthropic-version：
usageGuide.requestIntro: 使用 Anthropic Messages 协议：
usageGuide.docLabel: 查看完整 API 文档

python.code:
# pip install anthropic
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic(
    api_key="<api_key>",
    base_url="http://10.191.0.202",
)

message = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-fable-5-2",
    max_tokens=1024,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is the meaning of life?"}],
)
print(message.content)

javascript.installLine: 无需安装额外依赖（需 Node 18+ 或支持 fetch 的运行环境）

curl.installLine: 说明：macOS / Linux 一般已预装 curl
curl.code:
curl -X POST "http://10.191.0.202/v1/messages" \
  -H "x-api-key: <api_key>" \
  -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"claude-fable-5-2","max_tokens":1024,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is the meaning of life?"}]}'
